question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental Claw lifecycle diagnostic as a gated core Doctor capability in the current ownership stack?
rationale: The patch is not a repair to an established contract: it adds a new core diagnostic surface, changes Doctor results for opted-in users, and is explicitly marked for maintainer handling.

options.title: Sponsor the gated core diagnostic
options.body: Accept the read-only Doctor integration as part of the experimental Claws ownership series after the gate documentation is corrected and the dependency lands.

options.title: Keep lifecycle diagnostics outside core for now
options.body: Defer this slice until the RFC or a plugin-oriented alternative establishes a maintainer-approved permanent ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated core diagnostic
recommendation.body: Accept the read-only Doctor integration as part of the experimental Claws ownership series after the gate documentation is corrected and the dependency lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline indicates direct participation in the Claws discussion, while the decision is product direction rather than a mechanical patch repair.
